title: x-actors
description: Declares the actors who perform steps in an Arazzo scenario workflow. Each actor is bound to a role and optionally to a recipe-seeded entity. Required on scenario workflows, forbidden on recipes. See Arazzo Handbook §4.6. NOTE: the kit validates the structural shape (PascalCase role identifier); the closed role enum is project-defined and lives in the project's own Spectral overlay or in the project's `common/enums.yaml#/Role`.

propertyNames.description: Actor keys must be camelCase identifiers

actorRole.description: Role identifier in PascalCase. Must match a value declared in the project's role enum (e.g., `common/enums.yaml#/Role`). The kit does not bake in a closed role set — the project's own Spectral overlay enforces the value constraint.

role.description: The actor's role identifier (PascalCase). Value must come from the project's role enum.

description.description: Human-readable description of this actor's purpose in the scenario

ref.description: Binds the actor to a recipe-seeded entity via $setup.outputs.X expression

actor.description: An actor participating in the scenario
